title: Transformers.js
firstSteps: Run npm run dev to launch the extension
Click the extension icon to open the side panel
Type in the text box, or use the page text or your selection, and the model classifies it on your machine
useCases: Running Transformers.js models inside an extension
Classifying page text with no server and no API key
Reference for shipping on-device AI under MV3

store.summary: Classifies pages and selections with on-device AI.

justifications.sidePanel: Renders the extension's main interface in the browser side panel.
justifications.storage: Persists the user's settings and preferences locally on the device.
justifications.tabs: Reads the active tab's URL and title so the interface can reference the page the user is viewing.
justifications.contextMenus: Adds a right-click menu item that runs the extension on the current text selection.
justifications.Host permission <all_urls>: The content script runs on the pages the user visits to render the extension's on-page interface. Narrow this to the specific sites your extension needs before submitting.

versionHistory: 1.0.0 (unreleased): initial version from the transformers-js template. Not yet submitted to any store.
